steps.title: Open the management Adjusted EBITDA bridge
steps.decision: Read the seller's add-back bridge before touching any inputs.
steps.reason_quote: "Purchase price is a multiple of EBITDA, so every add-back is worth money. Read it first, skeptically."

guardrails.rule: Never accept a management-adjusted metric into the model without opening the primary source document.

steps.title: Validate ARR for Customer Acme
steps.reason_quote: "Amendment 2 supersedes and replaces the original order form, so it's a replacement, not an addition."

guardrails.rule: Read the amendment for 'supersedes/replaces' vs 'in addition to' before summing contract values.

steps.title: Assess the $4M relocation add-back
steps.decision: Flag the $4M relocation add-back for QoE; do not accept it as non-recurring.
steps.reason_quote: "A one-time cost that shows up in two or more prior years' invoices is recurring. This one shows up three years running."

guardrails.rule: A one-time cost appearing in 2+ prior years' invoices is recurring — flag for QoE.

steps.title: Verify the maintenance capex ratio
steps.decision: Challenge management's 1.8% capex ratio against the 4.1% 3-year average.
steps.reason_quote: "Capex below the 3-year average ratio needs a reason, or it goes to QoE. You don't suddenly need less capital after a buyout."

guardrails.rule: Capex below the 3-yr average ratio requires a documented reason, else escalate to QoE.

steps.title: Confirm the top-20 customer contract set
steps.decision: Open each top-20 contract and its amendments before trusting the ARR schedule.
steps.reason_quote: "If it's not in the top-20 folder, it doesn't matter yet. If it is, you read every amendment."

guardrails.rule: Every top-20 customer must have its amendments checked before its ARR is accepted.

steps.title: Build the ARR cascade
steps.decision: Beginning ARR + New Logos + Upsells − Churn, using validated contract values only.
steps.reason_quote: "The cascade is only as good as the contracts underneath it."

guardrails.rule: No ARR line enters the cascade without a validated source contract.

evidence.quote: only as good as the contracts

steps.title: Commit inputs and run the debt schedule
steps.decision: Do not commit until flagged items are escalated to QoE / legal.
steps.reason_quote: "Before this saves, the relocation add-back and the capex ratio go to QoE. That's not my call to make alone."

guardrails.rule: Escalate ambiguous contract language and recurring 'one-time' costs to QoE before committing.

evidence.quote: not my call to make alone

guardrails_global.rule: Never hardcode a management-adjusted metric into the investment model without verifying the primary source document.

open_gaps.question: Is the relocation threshold the same for every add-back category?
What evidence would make you accept the $4M as genuinely non-recurring?
What do you do when the VDR contains no amendment for a contract?
